public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();
        char[] ans = new char[100];
        int p = 0;
        boolean good = false;

        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (s.charAt(i) == 't' && i != s.length() - 1) {
                if (p >= 2 && ans[p - 1] == 'a' && !good) {
                    p -= 1;
                    ans[p++] = '@';
                    good = true;
                } else if (p >= 3 && ans[p - 2] == 'd' && ans[p - 1] == 'o') {
                    p -= 2;
                    ans[p++] = '.';
                } else {
                    ans[p++] = s.charAt(i);
                }
            } else {
                ans[p++] = s.charAt(i);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(new String(ans, 0, p));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
